user.title: APsystems storage (Modbus TCP)
user.description: Use the wired Ethernet interface dedicated to Modbus TCP. The device serves a single Modbus client: remove any YAML `modbus:` hub pointing at it before continuing.

phases.title: Grid connection
phases.description: Detected: {model}. Choose the number of AC phases (L2/L3 entities are only created for three-phase units). Tick the box only if the ELT's own grid CTs are connected: without them the grid power registers always read 0.

data.grid_ct: Grid current transformers (CT) are wired to the ELT

error.cannot_connect: No answer. Check the address (wired interface, port 502) and that no other Modbus client is connected: the device only answers one client.
error.no_serial: The device answered but no serial number could be read.

data.setpoint_keepalive: Rewrite the last power setpoint every (s), 0 = off
data.connection_max_age: Renew the Modbus connection every (s), 0 = only after a failed request
data.detail_interval: Read the experimental energy block every (s)

options.battery_dc: Battery DC: voltage, current, temperatures, SoH
options.elt_ac: ELT AC output: active and reactive power per phase
options.grid_ct: Grid power from the ELT's grid CTs (needs the CTs wired)
options.energy: Energy: daily and total charge and discharge
options.diagnostic: Diagnostic: ratings, limits, event bits, firmware
options.detail_energy: Experimental: PV energy from the ELT's PV CTs and PV + battery net energy (undocumented registers, one extra request)
